about: THE LOOP's backend. One JSON file, no server. A LOOP is one drive of a live night plus one hostile-critic pass over its photographs. A HOLE is one thing the critic saw that the design did not promise. Every hole carries the same eight fields — id, episode, beat, tag, saw, expected, so, next — and harness/the-loop.mjs goes red if one is missing. A loop may only claim done when it QUOTES CHROME (verbatim text photographed off a screen) and both live ports were left parked: 5178 (vite dev) and 5181 (John's live room) are never bound, never bounced.

loops.note: Backfilled from the record (CLAUDE.md H277/H278, Couch Plan Rung 1-2). The exemplar loop: every finding below with a dusk6- id came out of it, each one anchored to chrome the run actually printed, and each is closed by a named gate. This record is protected - do not wipe it.
